## Description

Trains deep reinforcement learning market makers inside a Wasserstein ambiguity set of order arrival distributions, guaranteeing robust worst-case spread quotes against adverse selection and inventory shocks.

## Where it may fit

Volatile spread widening regimes, toxic order flow environments, high-frequency crypto and equity market making.

## Vehicles

HFT Market Makers, Crypto Prop Trading Desks.

## Required data

Level 2/3 limit order book message feeds, trade execution logs, inventory position state.

## Caveats

Robust MDP training computational overhead is significantly higher than standard Q-learning.
